en: Illustrated postcard showing the Dalai Lama seated on a richly decorated throne in a Tibetan temple interior, with colorful murals, pillars, and framed images behind him. The lower part contains Dutch text describing Lhasa as the holy city of Lamaism and mentioning the Dalai Lama as the reincarnated Buddha, along with an advertisement for Liebig meat products and a facsimile signature.
